pure-announcement.rationale: It documents a reproducible attack technique with a threat model and decoder, not a product launch or release note.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts cover cross-modal prompt injection or image-carried exfiltration in coding-agent pipelines; the closest are session capture and MCP topics.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The attack is backed by a public PoC repo with a fixture, decoder, reproduction protocol and a full recorded trial, so a reader can reproduce and check it.

durability.rationale: The core insight — a review process that scans textual diffs but never interprets image semantics misses instructions a vision-capable agent later executes — is a trust-boundary mechanism that outlasts the specific GPT-5.6 models and trial counts named here.

actionability.rationale: It tells anyone building agent code-review or ingestion pipelines exactly what to change: extend review to interpret image and non-text convention-file content, not just diffs.

atomicity.rationale: The note carries one idea — steganographic exfiltration through a convention file pointing at an image, exploiting a cross-modal review gap — with the trial matrix and repo map as supporting evidence for that single technique.
